turns.q: Once it ships, how long is delivery?
turns.replyTail:
Once your order has shipped, delivery time depends on the items and your address. Small parcels are generally delivered within 48 to 72 hours. A mattress ordered on its own, without removal services, is eligible for delivery within 48 hours.

For other products, the estimated delivery date is shown in the “Ma livraison dès le…” section on the product page. Your tracking link will provide the most accurate update once it is available.

turns.q: Is there any way to speed it up if I need it sooner?
turns.replyTail: Unfortunately, we can’t bring the delivery date forward or ask the carrier to change its schedule. Your order will be delivered within the time slot communicated when you placed it. The courier may call shortly before arrival or if you are absent.

turns.q: What should I do if the tracking never updates?
turns.replyTail: If the tracking remains unchanged, first check the carrier’s tracking link for the latest status. To check your order specifically, please send your order number, the email address used for the purchase, and the phone number used when ordering.
turns.replyText: If the tracking remains unchanged, first check the carrier’s tracking link for the latest status. To check your order specifically, please send your order number, the email address used for the purchase, and the phone number used when ordering.

turns.q: How do I find my tracking link?
turns.replyTail:
Log in at tediber.com and open My Orders. Select your order to view the tracking details once it has left our warehouse and been handed to the carrier.

Depending on the carrier, the link may only appear close to delivery. For Geodis/France Express, it can be sent on the morning of the delivery day. For EDELIV, a live tracking link is provided 1 hour before the scheduled arrival.

turns.q: Do you compensate for a long delay?
turns.replyTail:
Compensation is not automatic for a delayed delivery. Each request must be reviewed based on the specific order and circumstances.

Please send your order number, the email address used for the purchase, and the phone number used when placing the order so this can be reviewed.
